top_signals.title: Bitcoin Whales End Selling Spree, Adding $2.9 Billion in 60 Days
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin has spent months mired in a slump that has driven out retail traders, drained billions from crypto funds and turned one of its biggest buyers into a seller. Now, investors searching for signs of a bottom are getting a modicum of relief from an old source: Bitcoin whales are buying again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
